record.text: 奥秘： 当一个友方随从受到攻击时，召唤一个3/6的水元素。

record.name: 蒸发
record.text: 奥秘：当一个随从攻击你的英雄，将其消灭。
record.text_en: Secret: When a minion attacks your hero, destroy it.

record.text_en: Freeze a minion. Summon a Frozen copy of it.

record.name: 脱罪力证
record.text: 直到你的下个回合，你的英雄每次只会受到1点伤害。
record.text_en: Until your next turn, your hero can only take 1 damage at a time.

record.name: 火山术

face.name: 绿洲盟军
face.text: 奥秘： 当一个友方随从受到攻击时，召唤一个3/6的水元素。
face.flavorText: 不错的，像母亲的手，抚摸着你。

face.name: Oasis Ally
face.text: Secret: When a friendly minion is attacked, summon a 3/6 Water Elemental.
face.flavorText: As gentle as a bellyflop.

face.name: 蒸发
face.text: 奥秘：当一个随从攻击你的英雄，将其消灭。
face.flavorText: 是不是因为死亡之翼的对手使用这张牌击败了他，所以他一怒之下引发了大灾变？我们不得而知。

face.name: Vaporize
face.text: Secret: When a minion attacks your hero, destroy it.
face.flavorText: Rumor has it that Deathwing brought about the Cataclysm after losing a game to this card. We may never know the truth.

face.name: 吉安娜的礼物
face.text: 发现一张临时的寒冰箭，奥术智慧或火球术。
face.flavorText: “今时今日，我的魔法将我们连结在一起。”——吉安娜

face.name: Jaina's Gift
face.text: Discover a Temporary Frostbolt, Arcane Intellect, or Fireball.
face.flavorText: "On this day, my magic will bring us together." -Jaina

face.name: 模拟幻影
face.text: 复制你手牌中法力值消耗最低的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 似曾相识的感觉。

face.name: Simulacrum
face.text: Copy the lowest Cost minion in your hand.
face.flavorText: It's like déjà vu, times two.

face.name: 爆炸符文
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，对该随从造成 6点伤害，超过其生命值的伤害将由对方英雄 承受。
face.flavorText: 有时候去读警告标识可能更加危险。

face.name: Explosive Runes
face.text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, deal 6 damage to it and any excess to their hero.
face.flavorText: Sometimes it's safer NOT to read the warning signs.

face.name: 巨龙怒火
face.text: 揭示你牌库中的一张法术牌。对所有随从造成等同于其法力值消耗的伤害。
face.flavorText: “来吧，赫尔穆克。只拿一枚硬币而已，她不会注意到的。”

face.name: Dragon's Fury
face.text: Reveal a spell from your deck. Deal damage equal to its Cost to all minions.
face.flavorText: “C’mon Hucklemuck. She’ll never notice if we take just one little coin.”

face.name: 买一冻一
face.text: 冻结一个随从，召唤一个它的被冻结的复制。
face.flavorText: 雪赚！

face.name: Buy One, Get One Freeze
face.text: Freeze a minion. Summon a Frozen copy of it.
face.flavorText: That's an ice deal!

face.name: 龙火护符
face.text: 可交易 发现并召唤两条龙。
face.flavorText: “……然后在冬泉谷的山里爬上爬下50次就可以了！”

face.name: Drakefire Amulet
face.text: Tradeable Discover 2 Dragons. Summon them.
face.flavorText: "...and I only had to climb up the mountains in Winterspring 50 times!"

face.name: 脱罪力证
face.text: 直到你的下个回合，你的英雄每次只会受到1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 那个靠枕知道的太多了……

face.name: Solid Alibi
face.text: Until your next turn, your hero can only take 1 damage at a time.
face.flavorText: That pillow knows too much…

face.name: 找不同
face.text: 发现并召唤一个法力值消耗为（3）的随从。如果你的牌库中没有随从牌，重复此效果。
face.flavorText: 啊，我总算看出来啦！右边画的是冰风雪人，左边是血精灵。

face.name: Spot the Difference
face.text: Discover a 3-Cost minion to summon. If your deck has no minions, repeat this.
face.flavorText: Ah, I see now! One of them is a picture of a Chillwind Yeti, and the other is a Blood Elf.

face.name: 火山术
face.text: 选择一个随从。当其死亡时，对所有其他随从造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 引爆火山，海底坐穿。

face.name: Volcanomancy
face.text: Choose a minion. When it dies, deal 3 damage to all other minions.
face.flavorText: Do it again, this time with Pompeii and circumstance.

face.name: 火焰结界
face.text: 奥秘：在一个随从攻击你的英雄后，对所有敌方随从造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 小心玩火，殃及四邻。

face.name: Flame Ward
face.text: Secret: After a minion attacks your hero, deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: Not to be confused with the burn ward.

known_local_policies: Gift uses the full three explicitly named legacy spell identities and current-turn Temporary lifetime; native discovery owns offer sampling and delivery.
Simulacrum uses actual current quoted hand prices and original physical slots, preserving current copy material.
Buy One Get One Freeze freezes the original residence first, then copies its current surviving material through the shared ordinary copy path.
Dragons Fury uses the original public deck reveal and captured current stored price; an empty reveal does nothing.
Drakefire uses the existing current-class plus neutral Dragon query and after-all two-discovery summon delivery; this timing is local and uncalibrated.
Spot the Difference checks the original player deck after the first delivery and repeats at most once.
Volcanomancy uses an ordinary granted minion Deathrattle and effect damage, with native controller/death lifecycle.
Solid Alibi uses a target-layer damage cap until the original player next starts; direct health loss is not damage.
